name: Yuri
source:
The quiet, elegant and intelligent bookworm of the club. Solitary by nature and constantly lost in the immersive world of books, she has a preference towards the macabre and sinister. An avid collector of knives - she's truly a maiden of mystery.

[From the [url=https://blueskiesmod.club/characters.html]official website[/url]]
